description:
Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-83549: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.. Product: SMA1000 Appliances

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_remote_code_execution_remote_code_execution_016", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cve%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%2026%') AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%CVE-%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%exploit%') AND "value" > 0
